record.rationale: Snapshot items before any worker and make all boards use that captured membership; keep slice plus whole-batch Promise.all. Bound dense/frozen arrays to 1000 and size to positive integers through 1000. Workers always return ordinary native Promises and do not throw synchronously, matching the taught domain; no synchronous-throw batch guarantee is invented. Require exactly one item argument, all batch starts before await, fresh dense output and exact reasons/values. A rejected current worker settles the result even beside a never-settling peer, stops later batches and does not cancel producers already started. Explain total linear wrapper/snapshot/result work excluding workers/wait. Cases mutate later items after the first batch starts, reject beside a never-settling peer, inspect original opaque values/arity and exercise one batch of 1000 with observed concurrency 1000.
